question: Which of the following is the product as a result of the process of hydrolysis of orthoclase?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaolinite.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• **Orthoclase is a type of feldspar mineral that is commonly found in igneous rocks.**
 
• Hydrolysis of orthoclase results in the formation of kaolinite, which is a type of clay mineral.&
